**Nomination deadline extended for 14th Annual Newcomer Recognition Awards:** County of Simcoe
The County of Simcoe has extended the nomination deadline for the 14th Annual Newcomer Recognition Awards to Friday, September 25, 2026. Community members may nominate individuals, organizations and businesses for contributions to the lives of newcomers in Simcoe County.
